relationships.subject: [11C]suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, the competition and saturation autoradiography results demonstrate that [11C]suzetrigine binds selectively to a finite number of high-affinity, displaceable sites consistent with NaV1.8.

relationships.subject: A-803467
relationships.evidence_quote: pretreatment with either the unlabeled homologous compound (suzetrigine) or the heterologous NaV1.8 inhibitor A-803467 markedly reduced the autoradiographic signal (Figure 3A).

relationships.subject: P-glycoprotein
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these data indicate that [11C]suzetrigine likely interacts with P-gp at the BBB, limiting its baseline penetration and complicating quantitative assessment of NaV1.8-specific binding in vivo.

relationships.subject: verapamil
relationships.evidence_quote: Consistent with a P-gp-limited transport profile, verapamil pretreatment (1 mg/kg, i.v.) markedly increased brain uptake of [11C]suzetrigine, yielding a 4-fold higher peak SUV (approximately 4 g/mL) within 5 min post-injection, followed by rapid clearance within 10 min (Figure 5B).

key_findings: [11C]suzetrigine showed saturable high-affinity Nav1.8 binding in rat brain autoradiography (KD 0.1 nM, Bmax 93 fmol/mg) and docked in the A-803467 pocket.
In vivo PET was confounded by P-gp efflux: verapamil or unlabeled suzetrigine pretreatment increased rather than decreased brain uptake.
